findings.summary: The rendered PNG carries no text anywhere. Both rounded boxes and the central block are blank, so a reader cannot tell that the left box is the read-only filesystem, the right box is the run's granted write roots, or that the middle block is the fence/worker. The picture is two empty outlines, an unmarked dark rectangle and two fans of arrows. The pixel histogram confirms it: only #2B2B2B, #929292 and #2E8B57 plus antialiasing are present, with zero light or near-black opaque text pixels.

Allowed versus refused is encoded by colour alone: grey (#929292) arrows turn back at the left box while green (#2E8B57) arrows reach the right box, with no legend or direct label on either fan. In greyscale printing or for a colour-blind reader the two directions are indistinguishable.

The figure is embedded in docs/evidence/fragments/a-worker-or-its-job-cannot-overwrite-shared-files/a-worker-or-its-job-cannot-overwrite-shared-files-s13.html as a bare

with no figcaption, so the page gives a sighted reader no key to the unlabelled shapes. The only explanation exists in the alt attribute, which a reader of the rendered page does not see.

rubric_items.contrast: PASS: no text is present to fail contrast; the marks that are drawn (#929292 grey and #2E8B57 green) clear their transparent/white ground. The absence of text is recorded under legibility.
rubric_items.data_ink: PASS: the four arrow strokes and their targets carry the visual weight; there is no gradient or decorative fill, and the single opaque fill marks the fence itself.
rubric_items.decoration: PASS: no gradient, background fill, drop shadow or stylised frame; the background is fully transparent and the only colours are flat grey and green.
rubric_items.label_collision: PASS: no label exists in the rendered image, so none clips or overlaps another or the data; the fault is the missing labels, not their placement.
rubric_items.legibility: FAILS: the rendered PNG has no text at all, so nothing identifies the two boxes or the central block and the diagram cannot be read at a glance.
rubric_items.table_form: PASS: the image is a boundary schematic, not information that is naturally a table.
